description: The pre-modern / VICTORIAN NATURAL-PHILOSOPHY world: virtue, rhetoric, the trades, and moral philosophy — a universal-region anchor grounding Cornelius Vane's frame.

microtheory.name: period_thought
microtheory.definition: The Victorian / pre-modern intellectual world of Cornelius Vane (1885): natural philosophy (science before it was called science), rhetoric, moral philosophy, virtue, propriety, and the manual trades such as blacksmithing. Timeless-side concepts present in a period frame.

concepts.name: virtue
concepts.definition: Excellence of character — courage, justice, temperance, prudence.

concepts.name: moral_philosophy
concepts.definition: The pre-modern name for ethics: the study of right conduct and the good life.

concepts.name: morality
concepts.definition: The system of right and wrong conduct a person or society upholds.

concepts.name: natural_philosophy
concepts.definition: The pre-modern study of nature — physics, astronomy and biology before the word 'science' (coined 1834) — Vane's own frame for the natural world.

concepts.name: rhetoric
concepts.definition: The classical art of persuasive speech and writing, a pillar of Victorian education.

concepts.name: oratory
concepts.definition: The practice of formal public speaking, prized in the period.

concepts.name: blacksmithing
concepts.definition: The manual trade of forging iron — a pre-industrial craft of the smithy.

concepts.name: husbandry
concepts.definition: The care and cultivation of crops and livestock; good management of a household.

concepts.name: apothecary
concepts.definition: The pre-modern preparer and seller of medicines.

concepts.name: propriety
concepts.definition: Conformity to accepted standards of behaviour and manners.

concepts.name: courtesy
concepts.definition: Polite, considerate conduct — a period ideal of gentlemanly manners.

concepts.name: decorum
concepts.definition: Dignified propriety of behaviour and speech.

concepts.name: etiquette
concepts.definition: The code of polite social conduct.

concepts.name: gentleman
concepts.definition: A man of good social position and honourable conduct in the period ideal.

concepts.name: honour
concepts.definition: Personal integrity and reputation, a central Victorian virtue.

concepts.name: temperance
concepts.definition: Moderation and self-restraint, a cardinal virtue.

concepts.name: prudence
concepts.definition: Practical wisdom in the conduct of affairs, a cardinal virtue.

concepts.name: disposition
concepts.definition: A person's settled character and temperament.
